name: TIC 30034686

text.card: A red giant 1,590 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.85 solar masses and 19.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,409 K at its surface.
